visual_goal: Show the board's question becoming a convergence register, from which owners, a migration plan and AI controls follow, all measured by fitness functions that feed breaches back to the register.
prompt: A left-to-right loop diagram on a light background. At the far left, a speech bubble held by an unlabeled generic board member, labeled 'One platform?'. One arrow from the speech bubble into a large central-left ledger book labeled 'Convergence register'. From the register three arrows fan out to the right into three stacked rounded cards: the top card labeled 'Org design' with a small team-of-people icon, the middle card labeled 'Keystone exit' with a small bridge icon, the bottom card labeled 'AI register' with a small robot-arm icon. One arrow from each of the three cards converges into a dashboard gauge on the far right labeled 'Fitness functions'. A long curved orange arrow runs along the bottom of the picture from the gauge back to the register, labeled 'breaches'. Exactly seven arrows in total.
alt: A board question leads to a convergence register, which feeds org design, the Keystone exit plan and the AI register; all three feed fitness functions, and an orange arrow returns breaches to the register.
